steps.note: Core after a double-cross with Quintero knocked out: nobody comes, and the player takes Kowalczyk by the arm. Cold reply, so no cracker line.

said: Nobody comes. Kowalczyk looks at you, and waits.
You take her by the arm. She doesn't fight you.
She told me you'd break it.
She goes out through the lock without looking back at him.
Zero Day has it. You didn't stop that one.
notSaid: Quintero comes in from the lock and takes Kowalczyk by the arm.
You thanked me for the cracker
